Priya (People Ops): Quick check — final panel for SDE candidate tomorrow 10:30 PT. Can folks confirm room + AV and who is the debrief lead? Also candidate is in CET (3:30pm their time) so please be on time.
Elena K: I can cover AV/room. I'll reserve Conf B and request HDMI dongles.
Samir Patel: I'll be debrief lead. Do we want to use the new rubric v2 or the short form?
Maya Chen: prefer v2 for behavioral, short form for coding? also link to rubric v2: https://intranet.redwood/rubrics/v2
Jonathan R: tiny conflict — can't do 10:30 PT, can we shift to 11? if not, I can swap with Maya.
Maya Chen: I can swap spots with Jonathan, happy to move earlier. @Jonathan R confirm?
Jonathan R: confirmed, swapping with Maya. thanks.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks — @Elena K can you add AV notes to the calendar invite and include the debrief doc? also @hiring-bot, send debrief reminder 30m after interview.
hiring-bot: Calendar invite updated: room Conf B + HDMI requested. Debrief doc attached. Reminder scheduled for 30 minutes after end time. :white_check_mark:
Elena K: Done — added the debrief doc and a quick checklist in the invite. Also left note: 'recording allowed? candidate opted out'
Priya (People Ops): perfect. last ask — reviewers please use the header 'Debrief: SDE-123' in comments so I can aggregate. Thanks all :pray:
Samir Patel: Will do.
Maya Chen: noted.
